stem: White material is observed on leaves, but no diagnostic structures have been confirmed. What is the best next step before a disease-specific response?
choices: Assume powdery mildew from color alone.
Examine representative material and obtain confirmation appropriate to the risk while keeping non-disease look-alikes plausible.
Delete environmental data because disease is suspected.
rationale: Visual similarity alone can be misleading; confirmation and alternative causes remain important.
